risk_summary: The excerpt combines detailed segment and sales data with substantial promotional language and broad, non-quantified descriptions of capabilities and strategic objectives. It identifies meaningful operating risks, including semiconductor shortages, labor and commodity cost inflation, logistics disruptions, COVID-19 resurgence, customer concentration, and vehicle-platform production declines. Overall tone is commercially confident but tempered by persistent supply-chain and demand uncertainty.
